heading, Our software is developed by people who deeply care about our health service, level 2
heading, With a personal goal to address its workforce challenges, level 3
With a personal goal to address its workforce challenges
end of heading, With a personal goal to address its workforce challenges, level 3

The concept of Locum’s Nest came from our determination and conviction to solve the staffing puzzle for professionals and organisations alike whilst working on the front line as Junior Doctors. We experienced first-hand how hospitals and practices had to dedicate so much time in arranging cover to resource patient care, and not forgetting the drain it proved on precious, limited finances.
— Co-Founders, Dr Nicholas Andreou and Dr Ahmed Shahrabani
heading, A platform conceived by people with a vast experience in healthcare design, level 3
A platform conceived by people with a vast experience in healthcare design
end of heading, A platform conceived by people with a vast experience in healthcare design, level 3

In my 20-year career as a Creative Director, having worked on some of the UK’s biggest digital projects such as the overhaul of NHS’ 111, I came to understand that for any product to be truly effective, it has to be accessible to all users - new and existing, young and old. Sounds fairly straightforward but, in reality, it is probably one of the hardest things any product team has to face – a never-ending cycle of thinking, testing, building and learning.
heading, Who focus on true partnership and personalised support, level 3
Who focus on true partnership and personalised support
end of heading, Who focus on true partnership and personalised support, level 3

What is an excellent product without excellent support to accompany it? We don’t just implement a product and run away. We build long term partnerships with our customers. Our users get to know us as people, and we get to know them. Our team has a ton of NHS experience with many of us having previously held the same positions as our customers.
heading, With a passion for best-in-class software engineering, level 3
With a passion for best-in-class software engineering
end of heading, With a passion for best-in-class software engineering, level 3

My top priority has always been the creation of an engineering team with diverse talent, skills and expertise. People that show real passion in what they do, love to learn new things, challenge themselves, enjoy sharing knowledge and tackle complex problems with the use of technology. Having worked on some of the most ambitious big data technology projects of the continent, I am happy to say this engineering team is one of the most agile teams I’ve ever worked with.
heading, And an exceptional track record in achieving results, level 3
And an exceptional track record in achieving results
end of heading, And an exceptional track record in achieving results, level 3

In my career, I’ve had the pleasure of working with some of the most innovative companies in the healthcare technology industry. I started as a founding member of Oracle UK and more recently, having helped grow Allocate Software to the leader it is today, I joined Locum’s Nest as its Chair, a company which brings a much-needed fresh breath of creativity and innovation in the healthcare workforce space
heading, By leading some of the most innovative ventures in the world, level 3
By leading some of the most innovative ventures in the world
end of heading, By leading some of the most innovative ventures in the world, level 3

Throughout my career I’ve worked with scaling tech companies of all sizes, in both the UK and the US, managing and mentoring expanding technology businesses. I’ve also seen the benefits a government can reap from well executed technology projects. As Chief Operating Officer for the UK Government, I was overseeing the consolidation of the Government’s vast web complexity (132,000 URLs) into the single gateway of GOV.UK. I am excited that Locum’s Nest is already saving NHS Trusts millions of pounds to enhance front-line services with a positive impact for patients.
